examples.en: You have beautiful eyes.
It was a gorgeous sunny day.
Excuse me, where is the exit?
There is no other way out.
A period goes at the end of a sentence.
This is our starting point.

examples.sr: [Ни̏ка̄ко] не могу да запамтим његово име.
examples.en: I just can't remember his name.
You must not tell Mom under any circumstances!
I didn't recognize you with a beard!
Can you identify this man?

note: to recognize a person; to find out news is «сазнати»

examples.en: Where is the men's room?
Act like a man!
We crossed the bridge on foot.
The Sava flows under the bridge.
That depends on you.
Everything depends on the weather.
I've been waiting for the bus for half an hour.
I go to work by bus.
This week I'm working the night shift.
We went to a nightclub.
Kids, it's time for bed!
I need eight hours of sleep.
You ruined my whole evening.
The car broke down on the road.

tips: Покварити се: to break down (ауто се покварио), to go bad or be spoiled (food, mood); of the body, «покварио ми се стомак» means an upset stomach.

examples.en: Their house is for sale.
Sales dropped this month.
The factory has a hundred workers.
He is a very hardworking employee.
The ice cream tastes of vanilla.
She has good taste in clothes.
Follow me and don't ask anything.
What comes after that?
Careful, the tea is hot!
It's very hot today.
My right arm hurts.
He is the boss's right-hand man.
There is no monster under the bed.
He's a real monster!
Good afternoon, Inspector.
The inspector is leading the investigation.
Sit still!
The night passed peacefully.
Give me a glass of cold water.
Why are you so cold toward me?
A strong wind is blowing outside.
The wind blew my hat off.
That was a very long time ago.
Long time no see!
Goodbye, and thanks for everything!
He said goodbye and left.
We spent the whole day at the beach.
Kids, we're going to the beach!
Do you have health insurance?
The car has no insurance.

tips: Kinds: путно осигурање - travel insurance, осигурање од ауто-одговорности - third-party car liability insurance, осигурање куће или стана - home insurance, осигурање моторних возила - motor vehicle insurance.

examples.en: The cat climbed onto the roof.
We live under the same roof.
I'm still weak after the illness.
This coffee is too weak.
Sit on this chair.
Bring one more chair.
I'm very grateful to you.
Be grateful for what you have.
My neck hurts.
She wears a chain around her neck.

note: not to be confused with врата (pl.) - door

examples.en: You hurt her feelings.

examples.sr: Имам чудно [о̀сећа̄ње] у вези с тим.
examples.en: I have a strange feeling about it.
The film is based on real events.
It was a real danger.
He works for a state-owned company.
Tomorrow is a public holiday.
What is the purpose of all this?
There is no point in waiting.
It's always clean at their place.
I'm asking purely out of curiosity.
Unfortunately, I can't come.
Unfortunately, he is right.

tips: Written as one word: нажалост. The two-word «на жалост» is a common mistake.

examples.en: Some people are waiting for you at the door.
I heard some noise.
I think you're wrong.
We all make mistakes sometimes.

tips: Грешити is also the everyday verb for to be wrong, with no religious tone: «често грешим» - I often make mistakes.

examples.en: See you on Friday.
We always go out on Fridays.
Grandpa raises pigs in the village.
You eat like a pig!
Where are you spending the summer?
He spends a lot of time on the phone.
Stop by my place after work.
I have to pop into the store.

note: свратити код некога - to drop in on someone
tips: Свратити means to drop in on the way: «Свратићу до тебе после посла» - I'll stop by your place after work.

examples.en: Look in the top drawer.
I need to seek help.
My son is afraid of the dark.
It's already dark outside.
My wife is pregnant.
She was six months pregnant.

tips: Used only of a woman. «Difficult» is тежак or напоран.

examples.en: Help! Somebody call the police!
Someone shouted «Help!» from the water.
She got a short haircut.
Life is short.
She won a gold medal.
He has a heart of gold.
We live outside the city.
That is beyond my control.
The guard wouldn't let us in.
He works as a night watchman.
I bought her flowers.
Don't forget to water the flowers.

note: collective, singular: «цвеће је лепо» - the flowers are beautiful
tips: Цвеће is a collective neuter noun used in the singular: «цвеће је лепо». A single flower is цвет.

examples.en: See you tomorrow afternoon.
I slept all afternoon.

tips: There is also the one-word form «послеподне». Written as two words, «после подне» is an adverbial phrase (after noon). As one word it is a noun: «лепо послеподне».

examples.en: We live in the twenty-first century.
I've been waiting for you for ages!
I can't take it anymore!
Hang in there a little longer!

note: impf. издржавати also means to support (a family)

examples.sr: Можеш ли да ми [прѐведеш] ово писмо?
examples.en: Can you translate this letter for me?
He translated the book into Russian.
We set out to look for him.
The search has been going on for three days.

note: у потрази за + instr. - in search of

examples.en: The power went out last night.
A strong current caught us.
Put down the gun!
Grandpa had a hunting rifle.
We are all waiting for your return.

examples.sr: По [по̀вратку] с мора почео сам да радим.
examples.en: After coming back from the seaside, I started working.
Many foreigners come to Belgrade.
Don't talk to strangers.

tips: Странац means a foreigner, but also simply a stranger. A foreign language is «страни језик».

examples.en: We must prevent an accident.
Nobody will stop me from leaving.
Mom is making lunch.
I'm getting ready for an exam.

tips: For cooking food, «спремати храну»: «Волим да спремам» - I like cooking. «Кувати» is to boil, or to cook on the stove.

examples.en: I trust you.
He lost my trust.
I take full responsibility.
A child is a big responsibility.
Turn right at the intersection.
The bank is to the right of the post office.
Children grow so fast.
Prices keep rising.
I'll gladly help you.
Do you want coffee? - Gladly!

tips: Радо means gladly, willingly: Радо ћемо доћи - We'll gladly come. The opposite is нерадо.

examples.en: Grandpa goes hunting every autumn.
The hunt for the killer began.
Give my regards to your parents.
Greetings to everyone from Novi Sad!

tips: «Имам поздрав од ...» - I have regards for you from ... To congratulate someone on a holiday, use «честитати», not «поздравити».

examples.en: You look really sexy tonight!
She put on a sexy dress.
I drink coffee with milk.
Buy a liter of milk.
What's for breakfast?
After breakfast we go for a walk.
Take these plates to the kitchen.
The storm blew the roof off.
I like your style.
That's not my style.
My daughter wants to be a princess.
Good morning, princess!
I can't control my emotions.
Who controls this territory?
He was accused of theft.
He is charged with murder.

note: оптужити за + acc. - to accuse of

examples.en: Don't judge people by their looks.
Judging by everything, he won't come.
The police burst into the apartment.
Did you get into trouble again?
Stop hitting him!
The rain is beating against the window.
The bus driver was polite.
He is an excellent driver.
The ship is entering the port.
The hotel is near the harbor.

note: not to be confused with лук (m.) - onion

examples.en: It's obvious that he's lying.
He was clearly angry.
What do you intend to do?
I don't intend to apologize.
It's too late for that now.
We arrived too late.
Our coach is very strict.
He works as a coach at a football club.
Get out of there right now!
My grandmother is from there.
Where do you put the keys?
Don't put your feet on the table!
The price includes breakfast.
Everyone came, including him.
Thank you for your support.
I need your support right now.
I live on the third floor.
The building has ten floors.

note: counted above приземље: трећи спрат - the 4th floor (US)
tips: Floors are counted from the ground floor (приземље): «први спрат» is the second floor in the US sense, «трећи спрат» the fourth. For a ground-floor apartment, look for «приземље».

examples.en: Are you happy with your new job?
The boss was not satisfied.
That man is dangerous.
This is a dangerous game.

tips: Colloquially of a person, «он је опасан» often means sharp and savvy, not as simple as he looks. It can sound like a compliment.
Colloquially of a person: «опасна правница» - a formidable, sharp lawyer; «Баш сте опасни!» - you've got some nerve!
Jokingly of a woman, «опасна Рускиња» means a femme fatale who could steal someone's husband, not just a dangerous woman.

examples.sr: [Ра̑дно] време је од девет до пет.
examples.en: Working hours are from nine to five.
Tomorrow is a workday.
Do you believe in magic?
That was real magic!
There is no justice in this world.
I'm fighting for justice.

tips: Правда is justice or fairness: борба за правду - the fight for justice. Truth is истина.

examples.en: I don't want you to suffer because of me.
He suffers from insomnia.

note: патити од + gen. - to suffer from

examples.en: The police caught the thief.
Thieves broke into our apartment.
The players are coming out onto the field.
I was out in the field all day.

note: «на терену» - out in the field, on site

examples.en: We swam in the lake.
The cottage is by the lake.
I have to work one more hour.
You did a good job with it!
Can you confirm the reservation?
The witness confirmed his story.
Are you aware of what you've done?
The patient is still conscious.

note: бити свестан + gen. - to be aware of
tips: «Бити свестан чега/да...» - to be aware: «Свестан сам да сам погрешио». Spelling: свестан, but свесна, свесно (the т drops out). «Несвесно» means unconsciously, unintentionally.

examples.en: Good night, sleep tight.
She smiled sweetly.

tips: As a noun, «слатко» (n.) is a traditional fruit preserve that custom says is served to a guest on a spoon, with a glass of cold water.
«Слатка вода» - fresh water (not salt), «слатке речи» - sweet words, «слатка вуна» - cotton candy.

examples.en: She is a nurse.
You need medical help.
Thank you for your visit!
We're going to visit Grandma.

note: ићи у посету - to go visiting

examples.en: My aunt lives in Niš.
Say hello to your aunt for me!
I warned you, but you didn't listen!
We must warn them about the danger.

note: упозорити на + acc. - to warn about

examples.en: Give me a glass of water, please.
We each had a glass of wine.

tips: Чаша covers a glass of water or of wine; a shot of ракија is also «чаша ракије». In Serbian «бокал» is a carafe or pitcher, not a wine glass, and beer comes in a «кригла» (mug).

examples.en: We had a wonderful vacation.
You look wonderful in that dress.
How much is that in pounds?
The ticket costs ten pounds.
That's against the rules.
You must follow the rules.
The ring fell to the bottom of the lake.
The keys are at the bottom of the bag.
Let's change the subject.
What topic are you talking about?
What will you order?
We ordered pizza for dinner.
Turn on the TV, the match is starting.
I want to include you in the project.
The application deadline is Friday.
My dad listens to old rock.

tips: Рок means a deadline or time limit (рок за пријаву - application deadline), not only music; in an older sense, fate.

meanings: to take cover, to get out of the way (reflexive form)

examples.en: Get out of the way!
Take those things off the table.

tips: Склонити се means to step away: «Склоните се у страну» (step aside); «Склони се с пута» - get out of the way (ruder).

examples.en: We have a little house in the country.
The baby is still very little.

note: affectionate; the neutral word is мали

examples.en: The police are chasing a thief.
Where are you rushing off to like that?

tips: Besides «to chase»: to hunt for (јурити везу - hunt for a connection), to strive for (јурити упис - chase admission), to run after girls. Јурити за ким is to pursue; бежати is to flee.

examples.en: I'll buy bread on the way.
By the way, have you seen Marko?
I can't sleep at night.
He works at night and sleeps during the day.
Let's start the meeting.
He started a new life in Belgrade.
Who acts in that movie?
Don't pretend you're sick!
Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
He's still in the bathroom.
Don't yell at me!
Why are you shouting? I can hear you.

note: викати на + acc. - to yell at
tips: «Викнути» is to give a shout, and also to call someone: «Викни ме кад будеш спреман» - call me when you're ready.

examples.en: Don't make me choose!
The shepherd drives the sheep to pasture.

note: терати некога да + pres. - to make someone do

examples.en: Fasten your seat belts, please.
They tied his hands.
If you have any questions, call us.
If he doesn't come, we'll go without him.
Journalists are waiting in front of the building.
My brother is a journalist.
I read the newspaper with my morning coffee.
It was written in the newspaper.

tips: Always plural and feminine: читам новине, ове новине су старе.

examples.en: Mom is baking cakes for the slava.
Would you like a piece of cake?

tips: Славски колач is a special ceremonial bread for the slava (a family's patron saint's day), not a sweet cake.

examples.en: That's unbelievable!
I had an unbelievable dream.

examples.sr: Шта имате да кажете у своју [о̀дбрану]?
examples.en: What do you have to say in your defense?
Our team has a strong defense.
I can't start the car.
We launched a new project.
I'm working on a study.
The results of the research are interesting.

examples.sr: Његова смрт је велики [губи́так] за нас.
examples.en: His death is a great loss for us.
The company had big losses.

forms: f. pl.; gen. груди; dat. грудима

examples.en: My chest hurts.
The dog jumped onto his chest.
What position do you play?
We're in a bad position now.
Listen to this song!
I should have listened to you.
I don't have internet access.
We need a new approach to the problem.

examples.sr: Не могу да [би̏рам], свиђају ми се оба.
examples.en: I can't choose, I like both.
Choose your friends carefully.
This light bothers me.
Plants need sunlight.

examples.sr: Да ли је [прѝстао] на наш предлог?
examples.en: Did he agree to our proposal?
The ship docked in the port.

note: пристати на + acc. - to agree to
tips: Also to suit, to look good on: «Та боја ти лепо пристаје». Пристати на + acc. - to agree to: «Пристајем!» - I agree!

examples.en: Try the local food.
We listen to the local radio.
Let's split the bill.
He divided the cake into four parts.
Do you really think so?
I'm truly sorry.
This is my colleague from work.
Tomorrow I'm going to lunch with my colleagues.

note: masculine, but declines like a feminine noun: колегу, колеге
tips: The plural колеге takes feminine agreement: Моје колеге су дошле. Although the word is masculine in the singular (мој колега), its plural agrees as feminine.

examples.en: Who broke the window?

examples.sr: Пао ми је телефон и [ра̀збио] се.
examples.en: My phone fell and broke.
Our team won the championship.
How did you win her heart?
Why are you so sad?
That's a very sad story.
My computer broke down again.
He sits at the computer all day.
Show me a card trick!
That's an old trick.
Are you cheating on me?

examples.sr: Ако ме сећање не [ва̏ра], био је ту.
examples.en: If my memory doesn't fail me, he was here.
Drive in the right lane.
She tied her hair with a red ribbon.
See you on Saturday.
On Saturdays I go to the market.
The fishermen are pulling in the net.
There's no network coverage here.
Children play on the grass.
I have to mow the grass.
He persuaded me to stay.
Don't try to convince me.
There was a strong storm last night.
The ship was caught in a storm.

tips: Storm, thunderstorm. To mean specifically a thunderstorm, say «олуја са грмљавином». Related words: невреме, оркан.

examples.en: They put us up in a small hotel.
Somebody framed me!

tips: «Сместити се» means to settle in, to find a place: «лепо смо се сместили у соби» - we settled into the room nicely; also to take one's seat: «сместили смо се у авион» - we got settled on the plane.
«Сместите се удобније» - make yourselves more comfortable; «Све се може сместити у ормар» - everything can fit in the wardrobe.

examples.en: She has big green eyes.
The light is green, go!
The trial starts tomorrow morning.
He testified at the trial.

meanings: to fold, to put in order

examples.en: I have to agree with you.
Put the clothes away in the wardrobe.

note: сложити се са + instr. - to agree with

examples.en: Last night we watched a scary movie.
He's an amazing guy!
I'm going to the store, do you need anything?
The store is open until nine.
The prisoner sits alone in his cell.
The body consists of billions of cells.
Don't throw trash in the street!
The kids are throwing stones into the river.
Understood, Major!
My father is a major in the army.
The pirates buried treasure on the island.
Lucky you, you're going to the seaside!
We all have our demons.
The priest drove out the demon.
What a lovely smell of coffee!
I smell smoke.

related.en: to smell, to give off a smell

note: usually a pleasant smell; an unpleasant one is смрад

examples.en: Why do you keep defending him?
Mom won't let me go out.
My uncle lives in Canada.
Aunt and Uncle are coming for lunch.

note: mother's brother; father's brother is стриц
tips: Ујак (also ујка) is the maternal uncle, стриц the paternal one. «Мамин син» means a mama's boy.

examples.en: Be careful on the road!
She is a very careful driver.
See you tomorrow evening.
In the evening we usually watch a movie.

meanings: to let in, to let go

examples.en: Don't let him in!
Who is playing this music?
Data processing takes a long time.
This is a cover of an old song.
The police took his statement.
The minister gave a statement to the media.
I watched a new episode last night.
What happened in the last episode?
She is still waiting for her prince.
The Little Prince is my favorite book.

meanings: to get in touch, to answer the phone (reflexive form)

examples.en: Why don't you answer the phone?
Keep in touch more often!

note: јавити се - to call, to get in touch
tips: «Јави ми се» in modern speech often means message me, let me know (on Viber or in a messenger), not only call. «Јавићу се телефоном» - I'll call.

examples.en: As you wish, Your Majesty.
Her Majesty the Queen arrives tomorrow.
A young man was looking for you.
Your son has become a real young man.
Come closer, don't be afraid.

examples.sr: На улици ми је [при̏шао] непознат човек.
examples.en: A stranger came up to me on the street.
Call me on my cell.
I bought a new mobile phone.
We have a mutual friend.
It's our joint project.
Careful, this is a trap!
The fox fell into a trap.
What a disgrace!
I'm ashamed to say.

tips: «Срамота ме је!» - I'm ashamed; «Срам те било!» - shame on you; «осрамотио сам те» - I disgraced you. Adjectives: срамотан - shameful, срамежљив - shy.

examples.en: In summer the kids go to camp.
We set up camp by the river.
I totally forgot!
This is total madness.
Knowledge is power.
I need a better knowledge of the language.
I smell gas.
Step on the gas, we're late!

tips: Гас is also the gas pedal of a car: «притиснути гас» - to step on the gas.

examples.en: The tourist season is starting.
I'm watching the second season of the series.
My stomach hurts.
Don't swim on a full stomach.

tips: Стомак (also трбух) is the stomach or belly; живот means life only: «боли ме стомак» - my stomach hurts, «живот је леп» - life is beautiful.

examples.en: I'll wait for you at the corner of the street.
We put the table in the corner.
What caused the fire?
He challenged me to a duel.

examples.sr: Из [одрѐђених] разлога не могу да дођем.
examples.en: For certain reasons I can't come.
We have no specific plan.
